text:
**We cannot tell whether clearing is happening today.** The latest available annual data cover 2025, and the evidence provided identifies tree-cover loss in 2021, not current activity.

In 2021, 81.3 hectares—2.23% of the property—were recorded as tree-cover loss. Most of that area (68.1 hectares) was mapped as planted pine forest; none was mapped as native forest. A further 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than the tool’s event threshold.

The evidence does not establish whether clearing continued after 2021 or is ongoing now.
